title: Cookie set without the SameSite attribute
description: A Set-Cookie response lacks the SameSite attribute, so the browser attaches the cookie to cross-site requests, which enables cross-site request forgery against the session.
remediation: Add SameSite=Lax (or Strict for sensitive sessions; None only with Secure for intentional third-party use) to every cookie.
limitation: One header value counts as one cookie: a folded multi-cookie single value may under-flag. Only a recognised SameSite value (Strict, Lax or None) counts as the attribute: an empty or unrecognised value is ignored by user agents, which then apply their own default, and that default is browser policy rather than evidence in this response. A `SameSite=None` cookie without `Secure` is refused by browsers and is reported by DPK-DAST-071. Responses that set no cookies never match.

headers.set-cookie: id=1; Path=/; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite = Strict
